J2.evidence: The verse «وتُصْبِحُ غَرْثى مِن لُحُومِ الغَوافِلِ» is rendered '...she wakes hungry of the flesh of unwary women — i.e. she does not backbite them': the 'i.e.' explanation is not in the Arabic and is unmarked; it must go in a [Translator's note: …]. Similar unmarked additions: '(for you, plural)' after «لَكم», and 'accused on account of [this matter]' for «لِكُلِّ مَن رُمِيَ بِسَبَبٍ» (the Arabic says 'by a connection/cause', not 'this matter').

J1.evidence: Verse «وتُصْبِحُ غَرْثى مِن لُحُومِ الغَوافِلِ» is translated, then EN adds unmarked interpretation '— i.e. she does not backbite them', which is not in the Arabic. It must go inside [Translator's note: ...].

J2.evidence: Entry discusses 24:11 (﴿إنَّ الَّذِينَ جاءُوا بِالإفْكِ﴾, ﴿والَّذِي تَوَلّى كِبْرَهُ﴾) but also substantively parses 24:9: «والخامِسَةُ أنْ غَضَبُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْها» with the takhfif of أنَّ, implied hāʾ, and the shahid «أنْ هالِكٌ كُلُّ مَن يَحْفى». That is the li'an verse 24:9 (وَالْخَامِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا), so the listing must cover 9 through 11.

J1.evidence: Entry is mainly on 24:11 (﴿إنَّ الَّذِينَ جاءُوا بِالإفْكِ﴾, ﴿لا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّا لَكم﴾, ﴿والَّذِي تَوَلّى كِبْرَهُ﴾), but it also substantively parses 24:9: «وقَوْلُهُ تَعالى: والخامِسَةُ أنْ غَضَبُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْها، بِتَخْفِيفِ أنَّ، ورَفْعِ غَضَبُ ... وأنْ مُخَفَّفَةٌ مِنَ الثَّقِيلَةِ» with the shahid «أنْ هالِكٌ كُلُّ مَن يَحْفى ويَنْتَعِلُ». That is the li'an verse 24:9, not a cited parallel. Contiguous range covering both: 9-11.
